packages.label_en: Prayer and Malkhut — The Holy Shekhinah
packages.reason: All ten nodes in this package share one essential nature: they are all expressions of the Shekhinah / holy Malkhut — the divine presence that is the primary subject of this Torah. The Rebbe explicitly equates all of them as bechinas of each other. תפלה IS מלכות (from the verse 'ואני תפלה'). תפלה IS אני — the divine 'I,' the first-person presence of God in the world. אלקים IS אני — the divine name Elokim is the bechina of 'ani' (the prayer text 'תנו עוז לאלקים' is explained as 'the ani'). אשת חיל IS מלכות — the Rebbe says explicitly: 'על-ידי הכח תתקן את אשת-חיל, בחינת מלכות.' התחברות IS תפלה — the word תפלה itself is linguistically 'לשון התחברות' (the language of bonding/attachment), as proven from the Aramaic translation. אתערותא דלתתא IS תקון השכינה — the Rebbe says 'כי מתחלה צריך אתערותא דלתתא, הינו תקון השכינה' — the arousal from below IS the repair of the Shekhinah; they are the same act seen from two perspectives. הקמת הברית IS זווג — the Rebbe says 'הקמת הברית רמז לזווג' — establishing the covenant IS the sacred union; they are the same divine reality described in two idioms. All ten concepts orbit one reality: the holy Shekhinah/Malkhut that is in exile and must be restored through powerful prayer. The eitza structure of the Torah is: pray forcefully → strengthen the Shekhinah → extract her from exile → achieve divine union. The bechina structure within this package reflects the single domain of holy divine presence in all its names and aspects.

merge_notes.reason: These two form their own raw connected component (a pair), but the Rebbe says directly: 'כי מתחלה צריך אתערותא דלתתא, הינו תקון השכינה' — the arousal from below IS the repair of the Shekhinah. The word 'הינו' (meaning 'that is' / 'namely') is the Rebbe's signature bechina marker: he is equating the two concepts as the same thing. The arousal from below does not cause the repair of the Shekhinah as a separate downstream effect — they are two descriptions of the same act. The Shekhinah (תקון השכינה) is the same entity as מלכות and תפלה in the main cluster (the Torah's entire subject is the Shekhinah = תפלה = מלכות). Merging this pair into Package 1 is a bechina merge, not an eitza merge.

These two also form their own raw connected component (a pair). The Rebbe says: 'הקמת הברית רמז לזווג' — establishing the covenant is a symbol/indicator of sacred union. More precisely, it IS the union: both describe the culminating act of the Shekhinah being united with her divine partner after being repaired. This pair belongs in Package 1 because הקמת הברית / זווג is the culminating state of the entire process: the Shekhinah (מלכות / תפלה) being united with the Holy One. The domain is identical: holy malkhut and her union. The relationship between the two nodes is bechina (shared essential nature — covenant and union are two descriptions of the same divine reality), not eitza.
